Watts made this hymn from Psalm 139:14, 17–18, "in the language of the New Testament": a paraphrase, not a translation. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

14I praise You, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Marvelous are Your works, and I know this very well. 17How precious to me are Your thoughts, O God, how vast is their sum! 18If I were to count them, they would outnumber the grains of sand; and when I awake, I am still with You. PSALM 139:14, 17–18 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ PSALM 139
Lord, when I count thy mercies o'er, They strike me with surprise; Not all the sands that spread the shore To equal numbers rise. STANZA I
